newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Rex's Sierra Leone diamond mine valued at $3.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Rex's Sierra Leone diamond mine valued at $3.3 bln.

text.p: Toronto-quoted Rex Diamond Mining Corp said on Tuesday that the value of its Tongo Field in Sierra Leone was estimated at $3.3 billion with resources totalling 18.9 million carats.
"Tongo Fields alone represents a potential gross profit of at least $1.4 billion for Rex," Rex Chief Executive Serge Muller said in a statement released in Antwerp, Belgium.

Rex, which owns leases covering the most promising parts of the Tongo and Zimmi diamond mining areas, said that the estimation of the Tongo field fissure resources had been carried out by Luc Rombouts, leading expert on diamond evaluation.
